turns.text: I'm going on vacation and I want to bring one book, but I can't decide which.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Basically there's the— right, hear them all first. I'll say when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a light romance set on an island, perfect for lying by the pool.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a thick science fiction novel my brother keeps telling me to read.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could finally read that classic novel I've been pretending I read in school.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all the options I've got, Moshi. Be honest, which is best?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The island romance fits the vacation mood perfectly, easy and relaxing. The science fiction one might be great if you'll have long flights or quiet evenings. The classic could feel like homework on a beach.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. Every checkout online now offers pay in four instalments. Is that a trap?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be. It's a form of credit, so it's easy to lose track if you use it for lots of small things.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Often not, if you pay on time. Late fees are where it hurts, and some providers report missed payments too.
